Theme 013 · Typography & graphic systems

LED Dot-Matrix Ticker

The film lives on a physical LED sign: a bezel of round diodes, unlit dots faintly visible, 5×7 bitmap letters with a soft bloom. Metrics scroll past like a stock ticker until one token freezes, the matrix inverts into a coral alert block, and a real arcade button waits for a human press.

readability ●●●trust ●●○effort med
1 · HOOK0:00–0:08

The amber ticker scrolls right → left at a constant speed. "38" lights column by column on beat 1, "OPEN TABS TODAY" steps in on the next three beats, and "3 READ" blinks on in coral on bar 3; the question crawls along the lower strip.

2 · REVEAL0:08 (drop)

On the drop a bright diagonal front sweeps top-left → bottom-right, lighting "ACME / PULSE" in teal. Dots ahead of the front sit half-lit; the backlit mark plate flashes on the downbeat and the lower strip reads "14 METRICS · EVERY MINUTE".

3 · PROOF MOMENT0:12–0:32

The teal ticker keeps scrolling until CHECKOUT reaches centre and freezes. The matrix clears, the coral block blinks 3× (150 ms) and holds on the downbeat with "−18%" punched out in dark dots; context types in amber, the sparkline drops, and the ROLL BACK button lights for the press.

Acme Pulse
4 · CTA0:36–0:45

Lines light top → bottom, one per beat. "PULSE" lands double-size on the downbeat of the last phrase, the amber ticker keeps crawling, and the "START FREE" box traces its border clockwise and fills on the final hit.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Dot grid — 80 columns at a 12 px pitch; unlit diodes stay visible at ~8% so the sign reads as hardware.
  • Bitmap font — 5×7 glyphs, scaled 1×/2×/4× by lighting blocks of diodes, never by resizing dots.
  • Ticker line — a clipped marquee of metric tokens running across the top row.
  • Alert block — a solid coral cluster with the anomaly punched out in dark dots (inverted text).
  • Pixel sparkline — one diode column per sample; the drop turns the last bars coral.
  • Bezel & hardware — screwed housing, a second fine-pitch strip for captions and real arcade buttons for the human action.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Marquee — moves in whole-dot steps (12 px) at a constant linear speed of 8 steps per beat at 120 BPM, so it never smears.
  • Diagonal reveal — dots light along (x + y) index with 8 ms stagger; the front crosses the frame in exactly one bar.
  • Alert blink — the block toggles 3× on/off at 150 ms, then holds steady on the next downbeat; bloom = 5 px blur merged over the dots.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

LED signs are pure rhythm and pure contrast: they read at thumbnail size and every change is a discrete step you can cut on a beat. The inverted alert block makes "one thing is wrong" unmissable. Risk: it can read as a retro gadget rather than a serious tool, so keep the copy terse and the palette strict.

Adapt to your product: put your live counters in the ticker and your single most important alert in the inverted block; keep each line under 13 characters at 1× scale.
